_comment: Read by scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs. Only for advisories with no patched release. Each entry is scoped to one GHSA id, one package and named audit units, and expires so it is re-reviewed.

advisories.reason: Low severity; affects deepmerge >=4.2.0 <=4.3.1 and no patched version is published (4.3.1 is the latest release). Only reached through jest-config, a devDependency used to merge local Jest config; not shipped in the published CLI or API runtime.
